descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-24 Deletions · S02 「养老院：同样三种删除在处理前做，不出现在摘要和记录里」 Nursing Home: the same three deletes before processing stay out of the summary and the note

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 A medication row, a task or an Important Point deleted before processing is not included in the summary (the pre-round Save Note result) or in the generated note.（UAT TC-24） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U10 Every TC-24 rule holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home, including deleting a Nursing Home resident.（UAT 3.3；UAT TC-24）

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Fresh physician. The Nursing Home resident is seeded with three medication rows, three open tasks and two Important Points.

When Delete the furosemide row, the point 'Monitor sacral pressure area' and the task 'Podiatry referral', confirming each. Type the pre-round text and press Save Note. Type the visit text, press Save & Extract, then Generate Note & Finish.

Then The summary and the note do not mention furosemide, podiatry or the sacral pressure area. The note carries today's visit text. The rows and items that were not deleted are still on the chart.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：U1 in Nursing Home (3.3). oracle.mjs: the summary and note checkpoints must not contain 'furosemide', 'podiatry' or 'sacral'. Positive controls (oracleRules 1): 'Donepezil' on the summary, 'Weekly weight Monday' on the task list and 'walker' on the note (today's visit text, which Post-Round does not show; a missing control makes the run Invalid). …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S02 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-24.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。
